nativeRun.runUnknown: Execution outcome is unconfirmed: {reason} Run ID: {runId}. Check the remote outcome before retrying.
nativeRun.usageUnavailable: Provider has not reported token usage
nativeRun.metadataOnly: Sequence, sender and size only; observing does not read or acknowledge message bodies.

nativeRun.unknown: The result is unknown. Check the current state before deciding whether to retry the operation.
nativeRun.acknowledge: I understand the original operation may have committed; abandoning tracking does not undo it.
nativeRun.windowed: Earlier body chunks have left this bounded display window. Server records remain; select the thread again to read from the beginning.
nativeRun.targetHelp: Selection only narrows scope; it grants no permission. Authorized non-SSH capabilities remain available without a target.
nativeRun.attachmentHelp: Explicitly bind attachments to this thread before sending their references in the input. The server still checks access.
nativeRun.attachmentsReady: Attachment bindings confirmed; sending will include references.
nativeRun.attachmentUnknown: An attachment binding is unknown; no Run was dispatched. Inspect read-only state and acknowledge the earlier uncertainty before a new explicit binding. There is no automatic replay.
nativeRun.executionDisabled: Execution is disabled. History and cancellation remain available; explicitly enable execution and configure grants in Settings.
nativeRun.runFailedReasonUnavailable: No specific failure reason was recorded. Check backend diagnostic logs for this run ID.

failureReasons.tool_failed: Tool {tool} failed. No more specific reason was recorded.
failureReasons.model_auth_failed: Model authentication or access failed. Check the API key and model permissions.

failureReasons.model_stream_truncated: The model stream ended before its completion marker. The reply may be incomplete.
